title: Restore 6 motivation relationship types DR's spec keeps (after Context Studio proposal b8ca98d2)
rationale: Context Studio's own motivation reflection (b8ca98d2, applied 2026-11-06) deleted 16 relationship types. DR's motivation rules pass removed 10 of them independently; the other 6 it keeps (3 of them are the types it renamed others onto), and they are still in DR's spec (0.11.0). The maintainer decided (2026-11-09) to keep them, so this proposal restores them in Context Studio. Once it is applied, Context Studio and DR's spec agree on the motivation layer, and b8ca98d2 can be marked landed at the DR commit that holds its other 10 deletes.
source_detail: documentation_robotics: restore after Context Studio proposal b8ca98d2 (maintainer decision 2026-11-09)

fields.title: motivation.value associated-with motivation.goal
fields.description: The value is the worth of reaching the goal to stakeholders, the reason the goal is pursued.

operations.rationale: DR's spec keeps this relationship type: Context Studio's motivation reflection (proposal b8ca98d2) deleted it, but DR's own motivation rules pass (485ebb03, spec 0.10.0) made it the type for motivation.goal.realizes.motivation.value's relationships (a rename in its change record), and DR's spec is the source of truth. This restores Context Studio to what DR's spec holds; nothing changes in DR.
